visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair tied back and wearing gold hoop earrings and a black off-the-shoulder top speaks directly to the camera against a white studio background. She holds multiple red-capped lip gloss tubes. A small video-in-video overlay at the bottom shows a historical clip. (2) Close-up shot of the woman applying a red lip product to her lips using a wand. She then places her hand under her chin, posing with a smile. The screen splits horizontally to show two different application thicknesses. (3) The woman applies a different shade of lip gloss and then dots it on her cheeks in heart shapes, blending them with her fingers like blush. She smiles and tilts her head. (4) Close-up of the woman applying a brown-toned lip gloss to the center of her lips and blending it with a fingertip. She looks at the camera with various facial expressions. (5) Demonstration of an orange-toned lip product. The woman applies it smoothly and poses with a hand under her chin, eyes looking slightly off-camera. (6) A vertical shot of a person's inner forearm showing eight distinct swatches of lip color ranging from deep red to light pink, each with a numerical text label next to it. (7) A hand holds two lip gloss tubes and a black bottle of foundation against the white background. Text overlays appear detailing a shopping promotion.
